fichas.title: Aeroplane types and ICAO categories
fichas.summary: Introduces ICAO Annex 14 aeroplane categories A–F and illustrates aircraft types with plan and side elevations carrying dimensional annotations. The category table lists example aircraft, from small leisure planes to large wide-body aircraft.
uses: Identify aeroplane types and ICAO categories

Aeroplanes

The convention of the International Civil Aviation Organisation
(ICAO), annex 14, classifies aeroplanes into categories, with
letters A- F.

small and leisure planes (Piper, Cessna etc.)
